items.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
items.content: OpenAI shares a framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing model misalignment, alongside six reports of unexpected or concerning model behavior.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI shares a framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing model misalignment, alongside six reports of unexpected or concerning model behavior.

summaries.zh: OpenAI发布了一个用于追踪、调查和披露模型错位的框架，并附有六份关于模型意外或令人担忧行为的报告。该框架旨在系统化处理AI模型与预期目标不符的问题，提高透明度和责任感。
summaries.en: OpenAI presents a framework for monitoring, examining, and reporting instances of model misalignment. The framework accompanies six reports detailing unexpected or concerning behaviors exhibited by AI models. The initiative aims to enhance transparency and accountability in AI development by systematically addressing and disclosing discrepancies between model outputs and intended goals.

items.title: How workers are unlocking new ways of working
items.content: New OpenAI Economic Research shows how workers use AI beyond traditional roles and which new activities become recurring parts of their work.
items.contentSnippet: New OpenAI Economic Research shows how workers use AI beyond traditional roles and which new activities become recurring parts of their work.

summaries.zh: 新开放AI经济研究显示，工人在使用AI时已超越传统角色，并将AI融入日常工作中。研究揭示了AI如何帮助工人解锁新的工作方式，以及哪些新任务已成为他们工作的一部分。
summaries.en: OpenAI's research reveals that workers are leveraging AI beyond traditional roles, integrating it into their daily tasks. The study highlights new activities that have become recurring as a result of AI adoption. The findings underscore evolving work practices driven by AI technology.
